title: The quadratic Brown--Erdős--Sós problem for 3-uniform hypergraphs with 8 and 9 edges
summary: The famous and actively studied problem of Brown--Erdős--Sós from 1973 asks for $f^{(r)}(n;s,k)$, the maximum number of edges in an $r$-graph with $n$ vertices in which no $s$ vertices span $k$ or more edges. In this paper, we concentrate on the case $r=3$ and $s=k+2$, with $k\ge2$ fixed and $n\to\infty$; then it is easy to show that the extremal function grows quadratically in $n$. Delcourt and Postle proved that the limit $π(k):=\lim_{n\to\infty} f^{(3)}(n;k+2,k)/n^2$ exists for every $k$.
